name: finance-month-end-closer
description: Closes and reconciles a seller's completed Amazon month: it retrieves the monthly activity, the settlements overlapping the month, the balances carried across month boundaries, and the payout statuses, then walks the seller through an Amazon-activity reconciliation, a payout receipt check (seller supplies bank deposits — there is no bank integration), and an accountant-ready summary. Read-and-explain only: it posts no entries, changes no accounting records, and never files, submits, pays, or moves money. Triggers on: close the books for last month, help me close January/last month, month-end close, reconcile last month, do my Amazon numbers reconcile, have I received all my payouts, give me my month-end summary for my accountant. Do NOT use for: filing/submitting taxes/VAT/GST or any regulated report, paying or moving money, changing prices/listings/inventory, accessing the seller's bank account, or the current in-progress month.
